subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should Control UI close this issue with a larger fixed initial history window, or require an older-message pagination UI using the existing chat.history offset contract?
rationale: Current source confirms the 100-message cap and an offset-capable backend, while docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for browser stability; automation cannot choose the UX/performance tradeoff for maintainers.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch and prepend older pages on demand while keeping the initial payload bounded.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed window
options.body: Close this only after maintainers intentionally land a coordinated fixed-window change that makes the extra fetched history visible and proven.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch and prepend older pages on demand while keeping the initial payload bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent Gateway/WebChat history work and is the best available owner for the product-shape decision.
